package.name: bacs_scheduler
package.description: Bandwidth-Aware Constraint Scheduling (BACS) node for ROS 2. Selects which inter-robot constraint candidates to transmit within a duty-cycle airtime budget, using the transmitter-side trust predictor and information-density ranking from the BACS paper. This is a reference implementation that wraps the algorithms in the bacs_sim package for deployment on the EMRMF pipeline.
